name: Arrows and Curves EA
summary: This EA uses a custom indicator called 'arrows_curves' based on a reversal period (SSP) with channel and shift parameters to generate buy/sell signals. It operates on new bar formation, opening positions when no existing positions are present, and closing opposing positions or applying trailing stops when already in a position. The strategy is a reversal-based system with configurable stop loss, take profit, and trailing stop management.
summary_zh: 该EA使用名为'arrows_curves'的自定义指标，基于反转周期(SSP)及通道和偏移参数生成买卖信号。它在新K线形成时运行，无持仓时开仓，有持仓时平掉反向仓位或应用追踪止损。该策略是一个基于反转的交易系统，具有可配置的止损、止盈和追踪止损管理。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于反转信号的均值回归交易，使用自定义指标'arrows_curves'检测价格反转点。入场条件为：当指标缓冲区0在索引1处非零时开多单，缓冲区1在索引1处非零时开空单。出场条件包括：固定止损和止盈、追踪止损机制、以及当出现反向信号时平掉当前持仓。仓位管理方面，支持固定手数或基于风险百分比的动态手数计算（使用CMoneyFixedMargin类）。资金管理使用风险百分比从可用保证金中计算仓位大小，并在开仓前通过CheckVolume验证手数有效性。该EA仅在新K线出生时执行交易逻辑，避免逐tick交易的过度交易问题。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is a mean reversion trading system based on reversal signals, using the custom indicator 'arrows_curves' to detect price reversal points. Entry conditions: open a buy when indicator buffer 0 at index 1 is non-zero, open a sell when indicator buffer 1 at index 1 is non-zero. Exit conditions include fixed stop loss and take profit, a trailing stop mechanism, and closing opposing positions when a reverse signal appears. Position sizing supports either fixed lots or dynamic lot calculation based on a risk percentage using the CMoneyFixedMargin class. Money management uses a risk percentage to calculate position size from free margin, and validates lot size via CheckVolume before order submission. The EA only executes trading logic on new bar formation, avoiding over-trading issues from tick-by-tick execution.

parameters.name: InpLots
parameters.description: 固定手数（若<=0则使用风险百分比计算）

parameters.name: InpTrailingStop
parameters.description: 追踪止损点数（0表示禁用）

parameters.name: InpTrailingStep
parameters.description: 追踪步长点数（0表示禁用追踪止损）
parameters.description_en: Trailing step in points (0 disables trailing stop)

parameters.name: Risk
parameters.description: 每笔交易风险占可用保证金的百分比
parameters.description_en: Risk percentage per trade of free margin

pros: 使用新K线过滤机制，避免逐tick过度交易，减少噪音干扰
具备完整的止损、止盈和追踪止损功能，风险管理体系较完善
支持固定手数和风险百分比两种仓位管理模式，灵活性较好
开仓前进行手数验证和保证金检查，降低因资金不足导致的交易失败风险
使用魔法号码区分自身仓位，支持多EA并行运行
pros_en: Uses new bar filter to avoid tick-by-tick over-trading and reduce noise
Complete SL/TP and trailing stop functionality with a reasonably sound risk management system
Supports both fixed lot and risk-percentage position sizing modes for flexibility
Validates lot size and margin before order submission, reducing trade failure risk from insufficient funds
Uses magic number to identify own positions, supporting multiple EAs running simultaneously
cons: 依赖外部自定义指标'arrows_curves'，若指标文件缺失则EA完全无法运行
止损和止盈对称设置（均为50点），未考虑市场波动率的非对称性
追踪止损默认禁用（InpTrailingStop=0），在默认配置下缺乏动态保护
当已有持仓时仅在出现反向信号时平仓，没有独立的持仓时间限制或亏损阈值平仓机制
ClosePositions函数中使用Symbol()而非m_symbol.Name()，与其他函数不一致，可能导致多品种运行时的问题
cons_en: Depends on external custom indicator 'arrows_curves'; EA completely fails if the indicator file is missing
Symmetric SL/TP configuration (both 50 pips), not accounting for market volatility asymmetry
Trailing stop is disabled by default (InpTrailingStop=0), lacking dynamic protection in default config
When already in a position, only closes on opposite signal; no independent time-based or loss-threshold exit mechanism
ClosePositions uses Symbol() instead of m_symbol.Name(), inconsistent with other functions, potentially causing issues in multi-symbol operation
improvements: 修复ClosePositions函数中的Symbol()为m_symbol.Name()，确保多品种运行的一致性
增加持仓时间限制或最大亏损阈值平仓机制，避免持仓过久导致过大亏损
增加价差过滤条件，避免在点差过大时开仓，特别是对于反转类策略
improvements_en: Fix Symbol() to m_symbol.Name() in ClosePositions for consistency in multi-symbol operation
Add maximum position duration or max-loss-threshold exit mechanism to prevent prolonged losing positions
Add spread filter to avoid opening positions when spread is excessively wide, especially important for reversal strategies

risk_points: 依赖外部自定义指标，指标缺失时OnInit直接返回INIT_FAILED导致EA无法启动
止损和止盈对称设置可能不适合所有市场条件，在高波动市场中止损可能过小
ClosePositions函数中Symbol()与m_symbol.Name()不一致的bug可能导致多品种环境下平仓失败
无最大持仓数量限制，虽然CalculateAllPositions检查但仅区分0和非0，可能同时持有多个同向仓位
risk_points_en: Dependency on external custom indicator; missing indicator causes OnInit to return INIT_FAILED, preventing EA startup
Symmetric SL/TP may not suit all market conditions; stop loss could be too tight in high-volatility environments
Symbol() vs m_symbol.Name() inconsistency bug in ClosePositions may cause close failures in multi-symbol setups
No maximum position count limit; CalculateAllPositions only distinguishes 0 vs non-zero, potentially allowing multiple same-direction positions
